mapper.select: SELECT id, incident_id, outbox_event_id, investigation_run_id, query_fingerprint, source_type, source_ref, query_text, snapshot_json, captured_at, create_time FROM sre_incident_evidence WHERE outbox_event_id = #{outboxEventId} AND source_type = #{sourceType} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, incident_id, outbox_event_id, investigation_run_id, query_fingerprint, source_type, source_ref, query_text, snapshot_json, captured_at, create_time FROM sre_incident_evidence WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId} ORDER BY captured_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT id, incident_id, outbox_event_id, investigation_run_id, query_fingerprint, source_type, source_ref, query_text, snapshot_json, captured_at, create_time FROM sre_incident_evidence WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId} ORDER BY captured_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sre_incident_evidence ( incident_id, outbox_event_id, investigation_run_id, query_fingerprint, source_type, source_ref, query_text, snapshot_json, captured_at, create_time ) VALUES ( #{incidentId}, #{outboxEventId}, #{investigationRunId}, #{queryFingerprint}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef}, #{query}, #{snapshotJson}, #{capturedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
